text:
alex_k: Quick preflight — planning to flip the geo-failover toggle tomorrow 2026-03-18 12:00 PDT. Goal: route NA traffic to EU fallback when p95 latency > 300ms or rw-large queue depth > 80. Model fallback: rw-small-aug. Sticky sessions enabled with TTL 6h. Canary = 5% internal only. Putting up this thread for final check + any last-minute guardrails. @maria_gonzalez @samir_patel

maria_gonzalez: thanks! can you paste the exact toggle payload and the expected metrics we should watch? also confirm the rollout window and whether low-priority customers are excluded from canary.

samir_patel: payload + quick flip command below. rollout window: 12:00-12:30 PDT, monitor for 15m then increase. low-priority customers excluded via audience filter 'tier!=enterprise' in canary.

```
featurectl set geo-failover --env prod --enable true \
  --scope 'regions=NA' --fallback-region 'eu-1' \
  --model-fallback 'rw-small-aug' \
  --canary-percent '5' --canary-audience 'internal && tier!=enterprise' \
  --sticky-ttl '21600'  # seconds (6h)
```

samir_patel: also recommended guardrails:
- circuit-breaker: failover disabled if model error rate > 10% for 1m
- capacity-throttle: don’t send > 30 RPS to fallback per-region during canary
- telemetry: flag flips should emit 'geo_failover.flip' tagged with canary=true/false and bucket id.

irene: added runbook link and SRE playbook to thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/geo-failover. please ensure oncall watches the following dashboards: routing-latency-overview, fallback-traffic, model-error-rate. @sre-oncall please ack.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle event created by @alex_k for 2026-03-18T19:00:00Z (2026-03-18 12:00 PDT). CI checks: config lint OK, smoke tests pending.

becca: small nit — for session stickiness we should hash on session_id if present, fallback to client_ip if not. that avoids rebalancing for mobile clients. confirm?

jonathan_b: agree with becca. also recommend sticky TTL of 6h but add an override to 30m for low-traffic routes (prompt-heavy p99 short lived flows).

alex_k: good catches — we'll set hash precedence session_id > cookie > client_ip, TTL 6h default with route-level override.

maria_gonzalez: telemetry checklist for canary: 
- emit 'geo_failover.request' with fields: user_tier, region_origin, bucket_id, routed_region, model_variant
- alert if fallback error-rate delta > 5% vs baseline or p95 latency increased > 50ms

sre-oncall: acked. I'll be watching model-error-rate and fallback-traffic. will escalate to infra if capacity-throttle triggers.

samir_patel: final ask — if anyone sees anything else, comment here before EOD. i'll prepare the patch and a small CR for config review, pinging @maria_gonzalez for signoff. :thumbsup:

alex_k: thanks team — will post CR link and remind on the morning stand.
